title: REMOTE Junior Backend JavaScript Developer
description:
We are looking for a Junior Backend JavaScript Developer to join our remote development team. They should have good knowledge in JavaScript and have good mathematical and problem problem-solving abilities.

The ideal person will have a good eye for detail, be able to deal with the pressure of deadline driven deliveries, be motivated to continually improve, and relish working as part of a remote team. This is an ideal opportunity to learn and gain experience in game development and work up to a more senior role inside a rapidly growing business within a team of proven industry experts, developers, and artists.

Main Responsibilities

• Working closely with the Head of Game Production, Mathematician, and Backend Lead Developer, the primary responsibilities of the role will be to:

• Prototype and demo innovative new game features in TypeScript and JavaScript

• Develop simulation tools that will simulate and calculate gameplay probabilities

• Assist in communicating with, directing, and managing outsourced game development teams

• Assist in the creation of new game ideas

Skills

• JavaScript

• Highly intelligent with a passion and ability to solve problems

• Strong communication skills; fluent in English

• Fun to work with

• Ability and equipment to work remotely.

Nice to have

• Experience with Node.js. Electron is a strong advantage

• Knowledge of modern HTML and CSS, ES6+, Canvas, or WebGL

• Experience with libraries such as PIXI.js, Easel.js, or TweenMax

• Knowledge of other programming languages: C#, Java, C++, etc.

• Experience with any Version Control System, in particular Git with GitHub

• Experience with containers and Docker

• Experience with Webpack

• Has played or enjoyed slot games, and / or other gambling games

• Plays and enjoys card games / board games / puzzle or strategy-based video games as well as other video games

• Degree in Computer Science, Maths or Statistical education

Who we are
4ThePlayer.com is an up-and-coming creator of online gambling games (slots, table games and others). The company was founded in 2018 by two luminaries of the gambling gaming industry, Chris Ash and Andrew Porter, who have a combined 40 years of gaming industry experience. 4ThePlayer has been tipped for significant success, winning industry awards and rapidly increasing our reputation for a forward-thinking approach to game design. We are on track for exponential growth and to become an industry leader.
Play our games here: https://www.4theplayer.com/our-games/

title: Junior Backend Developer (AI & LLM Focus)
description:
About Advision Development

AdVision Development is a forward-thinking technology team building innovative solutions for real-world problems. We are data-driven, user-focused, and driven by a shared mission to leverage cutting-edge technology to build robust and scalable applications. We believe in empowering our engineers to explore modern tools, move fast, and collaborate effectively.
What We Value
• Modern Thinking: You are passionate about learning and applying emerging technologies like AI and LLMs to create efficient, innovative solutions.
• Execution-First Mindset: You are eager to learn what inputs drive results and are motivated to contribute to team goals.
• Growth Mindset: You are committed to learning and improving your skills, embracing feedback to grow into a well-rounded engineer.
• Collaborative Spirit: You bring generosity and curiosity to team efforts, supporting your teammates to achieve collective success.
• User Obsession: You think from the user’s POV and are motivated to build features that serve our audience.
• Problem Solving: You are curious and persistent, eager to tackle challenges and learn from the problem-solving process.
• Candor and Clarity: Clear, respectful communication is the norm; you are open to giving and receiving feedback.
The Role

Advision Development is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Frontend Developer with a passion for modern web technologies and AI. In this role, you will be responsible for translating UI/UX designs into high-quality, responsive code. You will work in close collaboration with our Senior Backend Developer to integrate with APIs and bring our applications to life. This is a unique opportunity to build a strong foundation in frontend development while getting hands-on experience using AI-powered tools to streamline workflows, generate code, and solve complex UI challenges.
Objectives
• Develop responsive, high-performance, and visually appealing user interfaces for our web applications.
• Utilize AI and LLM tools to accelerate frontend development tasks, from component creation to testing and optimization.
• Collaborate effectively with backend and design teams to ensure seamless integration and a cohesive user experience.
Key Responsibilities
• Translate UI/UX design wireframes and mockups into clean, maintainable code using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Build and maintain reusable UI components using a modern JavaScript framework (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte).
• Consume and integrate with RESTful APIs provided by the backend team.
• Leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot) for code generation, bug fixing, and workflow optimization.
• Ensure applications are responsive across various devices and browsers.
• Participate in code reviews to learn best practices and contribute to a high-quality codebase.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in frontend development and the application of AI in the field.
Qualifications
• 1-2 years of experience in a frontend development role, or equivalent internship/project experience.
• Solid understanding of core web fundamentals: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
• Experience with at least one modern JavaScript framework (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte).
• A strong, demonstrable interest in artificial intelligence, large language models, and how they can be applied to frontend development.
• Experience consuming data from backend APIs.
• Familiarity with version control systems, especially Git.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
• Experience with frontend build tools like Vite or Webpack.
• Familiarity with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Pinia, Zustand).
• An eye for UI/UX design and a passion for creating intuitive user experiences.
• Personal projects or academic experience using AI tools for creative or development purposes.
• Basic understanding of backend concepts to facilitate collaboration with the backend team.

title: Senior Mobile & Backend Developer — Healthcare App (Remote, U.S.-Based)
description:
About us We build technology that helps first responders save lives. Our mobile app puts critical clinical protocols and AI-powered guidance directly in the hands of paramedics and EMS crews in the field — the people who show up on the worst day of someone's life and have seconds to make the right call. When our app works well, it helps a medic make a faster, better decision at a patient's side. That's the kind of work you'll be doing here, and it matters.

Where we are right now We're a growing company at an important turning point. Up to now we've outsourced our development overseas, and while that got us this far, we've decided it's time to bring everything in-house and build a real, full-time, U.S.-based team. This new development team will join our established IT company — so you'll be part of a bigger, stable organization, not a startup of one. As a small, rural-based company, our rates run leaner than big-city firms — but you get steady, long-term work, a low-ego team, and a direct line to a founder who values you. We want developers who are close to the work, invested in the product, and here for the long haul. This is a rare chance to get in early and help shape that team from the ground up — with a technical founder (a hands-on technologist, though not a developer myself) who genuinely values good engineers and keeps a friendly, low-ego environment.

The role We're looking for one exceptional developer to own our Flutter mobile app and its Laravel/MySQL backend. You'll work from home day to day, but you'll be a true member of the team — not a faceless contractor.

We begin with an immediate contract engagement. Once you've proven your skills on the actual work, we move you into a permanent, full-time staff position. It's a fast, fair tryout that protects both sides.

What you'll do

• Build and maintain our Flutter mobile app (iOS + Android)

• Develop and maintain our Laravel backend and MySQL database

• Integrate and work with AI/LLM services (OpenAI and similar)

• Own features end-to-end: design, build, test, ship, support

• Work independently while staying in clear, friendly communication with a non-developer founder

Required experience (mandatory — absolutely no exceptions) We keep the work approachable and the team easygoing, but make no mistake: we are completely firm on every one of these. If you do not meet all of them, please do not apply.

• Expert-level, verifiable Flutter experience — production apps shipped to the App Store and Google Play

• Expert-level, verifiable Laravel experience — production backend/API development

• Expert-level, verifiable MySQL experience — database design, queries, and optimization

• Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM services — OpenAI preferred

• You must currently reside in the United States and provide a verifiable U.S. home address

• 5+ years of professional development experience. This is not an entry-level or junior role.

• A proven remote/work-from-home track record you can verify

• Professional references we can contact

• Must pass an in-depth live technical interview, and complete both a phone interview and an in-person interview

Nice to have

• Ubuntu / Linux server administration

• AWS

• Healthcare or EMS software experience

• Experience as a solo or lead developer on a product

Interview process

• An initial interview will be conducted by phone

• An in-person interview is required. We're located throughout the U.S. and will come to you — we want to be sure you're a good fit for our team in person

• A rigorous technical interview covering Flutter and Laravel confirms your real-world expertise

Details

• Immediate contract start, moving to full-time W2 permanent after you prove your skills on the job

• Work from home, fully remote within the U.S.

• Visa sponsorship available for qualified candidates

Why join us This is your chance to be part of something that genuinely matters — an app that helps save lives, built by a team that cares about getting it right. If you want your code to do more than move numbers on a dashboard, and you want a stable home on a full-time U.S. team where your skills are valued, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $20.00 - $50.00 per hour

Benefits:

• 401(k)

• Flexible schedule

• Paid time off

• Retirement plan

• Tuition reimbursement

Application Question(s):

• Do you understand that this role requires verifiable, expert-level experience in Flutter, Laravel, and MySQL, and that we confirm this through references and a technical interview? (Yes/No)

• Which U.S. state do you currently live in? Please note we verify residency and a home address as part of hiring. Are you comfortable with that? (Yes/No + state)

• An in-person interview is required so we can be sure you're a good fit for our team. We're located throughout the U.S. and will come to you. Which city and state are you located in, and are you comfortable meeting in person? (City/State + Yes/No)

• How many years of professional, paid development experience do you have, and how many were in a fully remote role? Please name an employer or client we can verify.

• Share links to two production apps you built in Flutter that are currently live on the App Store or Google Play, and describe your specific role on each.

• Describe a Laravel + MySQL backend you personally built and shipped, and your hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM services such as OpenAI — what you built, the database structure, and what you were responsible for.

• This role includes an in-depth, hands-on technical interview covering Flutter and Laravel. Are you comfortable completing a rigorous live technical assessment? (Yes/No)

• Can you provide professional references we may contact? (Yes/No)

• How would you rate your experience with Ubuntu/Linux server administration and AWS? (None / Basic / Intermediate / Advanced)

• Have you ever been convicted of a crime? If yes, please briefly explain. (We consider each situation individually and in accordance with applicable law.)

• This role begins as a contract engagement. What is your expected hourly rate? Our budgeted range is $20–$50/hr depending on experience. (Please state your rate.)

Work Location: Remote

title: Junior Backend .Net Engineer
description:
ABOUT METRC

Metrc is the most trusted and experienced provider of cannabis regulatory systems in the United States and is growing extremely rapidly to expand globally. We provide a solution that combines advanced software, radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology, a dedicated customer-support team, and a secure database to track and trace cannabis from growth, harvest, and processing to testing, transport, and sale.

GENERAL OVERVIEW

We are seeking a motivated Backend .NET Engineer to support the development and maintenance of scalable backend systems that power our enterprise applications. This role focuses on server-side development using modern .NET technologies while collaborating with experienced engineers to build secure, high-performance services and APIs.

The ideal candidate is eager to grow their technical skills, contribute to backend development efforts, and learn best practices in software engineering within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Assist in developing backend services using .NET Framework / .NET 10 and C#.
• Support the development and maintenance of RESTful APIs used by web and mobile applications.
• Collaborate with senior engineers to build scalable and secure backend systems.
• Work with front-end engineers to integrate user-facing elements with backend services.
• Contribute to database development and maintenance using SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established engineering standards.
• Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve development practices.
• Assist in troubleshooting application issues and supporting production systems.
• Contribute to automated testing and follow Test Driven Development (TDD) practices.
• Participate in Agile development processes including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
• Continue developing technical skills and stay informed on evolving .NET technologies.
• May perform other additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS- KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 0–2 years of experience in software development (internships or academic projects considered).
• Basic proficiency in C# and .NET Core / .NET technologies.
• Familiarity with REST APIs and backend development concepts.
• Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
• Knowledge of object-oriented programming principles.
• Exposure to version control systems (e.g., Git).
• Strong willingness to learn and grow in a collaborative engineering environment.
• Effective problem-solving and communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS- KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES
• Experience with ASP.NET Web API or similar frameworks.
• Exposure to ORMs such as Dapper or Entity Framework.
• Familiarity with Agile development environments.
• Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices.
• Internship or project experience developing backend applications.

TRAVEL

Minimal travel expected. Occasional travel for leadership meetings or cross-functional collaboration.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

In-office and remote position
• Frequently required to sit
• Frequently required to talk or hear
• Continually utilize visual acuity to operate equipment, read technical information, and/or use a keyboard and mouse.

WHY JOIN US?
• Be a key leader in a high-growth SaaS company transforming the cannabis industry.
• Shape the future of Metrc’s front-end experience, driving a critical transition to a modern, scalable architecture.
• Work in a collaborative, innovative environment with direct access to the Director of Engineering and Senior Leadership.
• Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

DITL

It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
